short.en: One search box for everything: tickets, problems, changes (incl. followups and tasks), knowledge base, assets (serial, IP, MAC), users, software, documents and projects. Filters, status icons, search by person, pagination.

long.en:
Replaces GLPI's top search bar with a full-text search across:
- **Tickets, problems, changes**: title, description, followups and tasks, in any status (closed included) - **Knowledge base**: article title and content - **Assets** (computers, network devices, printers, phones, monitors, peripherals): name, serial, inventory number, contact, comments, **IP address** and **MAC address** - **Users**: login, name, email, phone, administrative number - **Software, documents, projects**
Features:
- Results in tabs per type with counts, GLPI's colored status icon on every ticket, highlighted snippets. - **Filters**: status (open / pending / solved / closed), last updated (presets or a date range), where the words were found, sort, page size. - **Touched by**: pick a person to list everything they were requester, observer or assigned on, opened, updated, or wrote a followup, task or solution on (and their assets, software, documents and projects). - **Pagination**: every result is reachable. - **Respects GLPI permissions**: entities, "see all / my group / my own" rights, private followups and tasks, knowledge base targets. - No external requests: works on air-gapped servers.
Works on GLPI 10.0, 11.0 and 12.0 from one package. Requires PHP 8.1+.
